measured: call edge precision and recall against a type checker on pinned checkouts

method.unit: call site: (caller file, line, callee name)
method.oracle: For every call expression in the checkout the language's own type checker is asked for the callee's declarations. A site is in-repo when every declaration is inside the checkout, external when the checker resolves it to a package or stub outside the checkout, and undecided when the checker returns nothing.
method.trueEdge: the oracle decided the site and the symbol span osnova names contains one of the oracle's declaration lines in the same file
method.falseEdge: the oracle decided the site and the symbol span osnova names contains none of the oracle's declarations, including an in-repo target where the checker says the callee is external
method.undecidedEdge: the oracle has no verdict for the site; excluded from both rates
method.recall: distinct in-repo oracle sites covered by at least one true osnova edge / distinct in-repo oracle sites
method.python: every ast.Call callee identifier in every .py file, sent to pyright-langserver textDocument/definition
method.typescript: every CallExpression and NewExpression in one ts.Program over every .ts and .tsx file, resolved with checker.getSymbolAtLocation and getAliasedSymbol

zod-v1.change: the 35 removed false edges are the shadowed-declaration refusal; the 14 lost sites are calls where the surviving record happened to be the one in scope

click-v1.change: scored before the Python decorator-factory edges landed in 0.7.0; the recall gain is those edges, and the shadowed-declaration refusal changed nothing on this corpus

limitations: The oracle harness (site extraction, checker driver and scorer) is not shipped in this repository; the record is descriptive and the method section states what it did.
The checker's own resolution is the ground truth; where it returns nothing the site is undecided and counts in neither rate.
Line tolerance of one absorbs multi-line call formatting and could mask a wrong target declared on an adjacent line.
Two corpora and two languages; the other pinned checkouts were not scored.
Recall counts osnova call edges only; import, reference, extends and routes edges are not scored here.
